lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately four to five horizontal rows of high-luminance circular clusters are visible posterior to the gill slits, following a semi-linear trajectory toward the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of spots, creating a discernible grid-like arrangement of nodes along the medial-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the dorsal-lateral surface; the primary ridge displays a high-contrast luminance gradient with highlights on the upper edge and defined shadowing on the lower edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a sparse distribution of high-luminance blobs, primarily concentrated toward the anterior base and becoming more diffuse toward the apex and trailing edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced light caustics from the water surface create transient high-intensity patterns across the dorsal region, occasionally masking the underlying dermal pigmentation.
